input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal in duration to the previous term (so a multi-year initial term auto-renews for multiple years, which is walk-away territory) and requires 90 days' non-renewal notice, far exceeding the fallback ceiling of 60 days. There is no renewal reminder and no cap on renewal charges anywhere (§ 4.1 Charges is silent on uplift). Redline moves to the preferred position: 12-month renewal terms, 30-day exit notice, 60-day vendor reminder and a CPI/3% uplift cap; a 60-day window with a 5% cap is offered as fallback.

ops.oldText: for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
ops.newText: for an additional term of twelve (12) months unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment. IBM will notify Customer in writing of each upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Charges for any renewal term will not increase by more than the lesser of (i) the increase in the U.S. Consumer Price Index over the then-current term and (ii) three percent (3%) of the Charges for the then-current term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window to 30 days, fixed renewal terms at 12 months, and added a renewal reminder and a cap on renewal price increases, consistent with our playbook position that renewals be easy to exit and predictably priced. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day notice window and a 5% uplift cap as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Renewal term set to 12 months, notice window cut from 90 to 30 days, 60-day renewal reminder and CPI/3% uplift cap added.
